ev.q: During 2006–2013, the percentage of physicians using any EHR system increased 168%, from 29.2% in 2006 to 78.4% in 2013.
Source: Hsiao CJ , Hing E. Use and characteristics of electronic health record systems
Source: Hsiao CJ , Hing E. Use and characteristics of electronic health record systems
* A sample survey of office-based physicians.
